SavepointStmt.doc: One of the three savepoint-family statements. Each carries a single owned identifier — the savepoint name. The variant tag distinguishes intent: declare, release, or partial-rollback. The compiler maps each variant to the matching VDBE opcode (Savepoint / ReleaseSavepoint / RollbackToSavepoint).

Savepoint.doc: `SAVEPOINT name` — declare a new savepoint. Pushes a frame onto the savepoint stack at runtime. If the stack is empty when this runs, an implicit outer transaction is started.

Release.doc: `RELEASE [SAVEPOINT] name` — discard the savepoint with this name and every savepoint above it. Changes made under those frames are kept (merged into the next-outer frame). If `name` is the OUTERMOST savepoint and there is no enclosing transaction, the implicit outer transaction commits.

RollbackTo.doc: `ROLLBACK [TRANSACTION] TO [SAVEPOINT] name` — revert all changes made since the savepoint named `name` was declared. The savepoint frame itself REMAINS on the stack (subsequent RELEASE / ROLLBACK TO with the same name still resolves). Any savepoints DEEPER than `name` are also discarded as a side effect.

SavepointParseOk.doc: Successful savepoint-family parse: the statement plus the index of the next un-consumed token (typically the terminating `;` or `Eof`).

parse_savepoint_family.doc: Parse one of `SAVEPOINT name` / `RELEASE [SAVEPOINT] name` / `ROLLBACK [TRANSACTION] TO [SAVEPOINT] name` starting at `start` in `tokens`. The token at `start` MUST be one of `KwSavepoint`, `KwRelease`, or `KwRollback`. A bare `ROLLBACK` (not followed by `TRANSACTION` or `TO`) is rejected with `"deferred: bare ROLLBACK (transaction rollback)"` — that form is owned by the transaction-stmt parser.
